package.limitNote: Uncompiled source estimate only, not a WeChat package-size measurement

limits: Does not run WeChat compiler or renderer, real device, backend, or real ad/settlement.
Dynamic images, route expressions, event names, runtime data and native SDK semantics require runtime validation.
wxParse injected handlers are accepted only for pages that invoke wxParse and only when the assignment exists in the adapter; all other imported-template handlers are checked.
All page module evaluation uses offline wx/request stubs; no lifecycle or network calls execute.
